name: ENSORCELLED ROUNDS
text: Friendly Warpcoven operatives' inferno boltguns, inferno bolt pistols and autopistols have Devastating 1.

name: DAEMONMAW WEAPONS
text: Friendly Rubric Marines' melee weapons get +1 Atk, and Accurate 1 while the Rubric Marine is retaliating.

name: ARCANE ROBES
text: Once per turning point, when an attack die would inflict Critical Dmg on a friendly Sorcerer, it inflicts that weapon's Normal Dmg instead.

name: SORCEROUS SCROLLS
text: Once per battle, when a friendly Sorcerer is activated or counteracts, give it a different Boon of Tzeentch for the rest of the battle (it loses its old one). It cannot be a boon another friendly operative has.
